info.title: MyScoutee participation-tickets
info.description: Native ticket snapshots, holder-batch queries and check-in. Reuses EventOwnershipDto for the existing event view. Check-in stays at events with its canonical credential/state validation; assets retains its preceding access checks. No automatic retries. REAL/DEMO and job scope preserved. 2 MiB request and 8 MiB response bounds; no-store. Cross-owner write/reply recovery remains milestone 16.
